title: CAN-FD SAE Benchmark Workload & Message Set Configuration
description: Standard SAE automotive message set extended with CISG 4-domain bus segmentation, Category 1 runtime telemetry, Category 2 PQC attestation burst, and Category 3.2 selective NACK frames.

message_streams.name: Powertrain / Engine ECM Control
message_streams.description: High-frequency engine speed (RPM), throttle, and torque control.

message_streams.name: Transmission & Traction Control
message_streams.description: Transmission gear status, clutch pressure, and traction intervention.

message_streams.name: Chassis Control (Steering & Braking)
message_streams.description: Steering wheel angle, brake master cylinder pressure, yaw rate.

message_streams.name: PQC ML-DSA-44 Boot Attestation Burst
message_streams.description: 41-frame 60/4 block transfer of 2436-byte Post-Attestation Object (2420-byte ML-DSA-44 signature + 16-byte Ascon-AEAD128 tag).

message_streams.name: Selective NACK Error Recovery
message_streams.description: 16-byte selective retransmission request with 64-bit missing frame bitmap. Budgeted at half of 50ms FTTI.

message_streams.name: Wheel Speeds (4 Individual Wheels)
message_streams.description: Front-Left, Front-Right, Rear-Left, Rear-Right individual wheel pulse counters.

message_streams.name: Engine Thermal Management
message_streams.description: Engine coolant temperature, radiator fan duty cycle, oil temperature.

message_streams.name: Body Control Module (BCM)
message_streams.description: Exterior lighting, door latches, wipers, climate control status.

message_streams.name: OBD-II Diagnostics & UDS Telemetry
message_streams.description: Standard diagnostic test routine, DTC polling, and telematics telemetry.
